# Equipment: every piece of gear and tool

<!-- generated by node tools/gen-docs.js: do not edit by hand, change the code and run it again -->
Every item in `ITEM` (7 pieces × 6 level tiers × 5 rarities = 210) and the 90 profession tools, with the numbers the server uses and where they are defined. Dungeon loot (docs/DUNGEONS.md) is built from these.

Generated from the live code by `node tools/gen-docs.js` (`--check` tells you when this file is out of date). Line numbers are those of the code when it was generated.

## 2. How the stats are made

- **Weapon attack** = round(TIER_ATK[tier] × RAR_MULT[rarity]). The weapon you wield sets your class (sword: Warrior, bow: Archer, wand: Mage). A player's damage is `(3 f(L) + gear attack) × (1 + symbol)`.
- **Armour health** = round(ARMOR_HP[piece][tier] × RAR_MULT[rarity]); **defense** = max(ARMOR_DEF[piece][tier] + rarity, round(ARMOR_DEF × RAR_MULT)). A player's health is `(20 f(L) + gear health) × (1 + passives) × (1 + symbol)`; damage taken is cut by `def / (def + 60)`.
- **Price** = round(PRICE[tier] × SLOT_PRICE[piece] × 3^rarity); sells for 40% (`sellPrice`). Only **common** items are in the shops, unlimited, each copy bought costs 20% of the base more until sunrise.
- **Level**: an item needs `lv` = TIER_LV[tier] (1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25) to be worn. Tiers 1-4 are the home forest's, 5-6 the Sakura Vale's samurai gear; **tier 6 is the top**: levels 25-30 (the Hoarfrost Reach) still drop tier 6.
- **Rarity** (Common ×1, Rare ×1.3, Epic ×1.7, Unique ×2.2, Legendary ×3): 3 identical items merge into one of the next rarity at the forge (same tier needed). Drops: a monster 2% common, 0.5% rare, 0.1% epic per kill; a boss 50 / 10 / 3 / 1 / 0.1% (common to legendary). The rarity is rolled first, then one of the seven pieces with equal chance, of the tier of the monster's level (`tierFor`).
- **Crafting** makes common, rare and epic pieces only (unique and legendary come from drops and merging); a tier's weapons cost ore, its armour logs, plus 10% of the price in coins.
- Id scheme: `<piece><tier 1-6>[-r|-e|-u|-l]`: `sword2` is a common Iron Longsword, `sword2-e` the epic one.

## 4. Rarities

| Rarity | Suffix | Stat multiplier | Price multiplier | Monster drop | Boss drop | Crafted | Tool double-yield chance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Common | (none) | ×1 | ×1 | 2% | 50% | yes | +0% |
| Rare | `-r` | ×1.3 | ×3 | 0.5% | 10% | yes | +8% |
| Epic | `-e` | ×1.7 | ×9 | 0.1% | 3% | yes | +16% |
| Unique | `-u` | ×2.2 | ×27 | — | 1% | no | +26% |
| Legendary | `-l` | ×3 | ×81 | — | 0.1% | no | +40% |

## 5. Every piece of gear (210)

One table per slot, in the order tier, then rarity. **Price** is the item's value (the shop price of the first common copy; rarer items are not sold), **Sell** what a shop pays, **Craft** the cost at the smith or armourer (ore for weapons, logs for armour; `—` where it cannot be crafted). **Ref** is the entry of `SLOT_NAMES` the name comes from.

## 6. Profession tools (90)

Three tool slots (`eq.pick`, `eq.axe`, `eq.sickle`), the same 6 tiers and 5 rarities as gear but **no combat stats**: the tier decides which resource nodes it can work (a node needs a tool of tier `need` or better) and the rarity how often a node gives a double yield. Bought (common only) at a Wayfarers' Lodge, merged at the forge. Defined in `items.js` (src/shared/items.js:35), not part of `ITEM_LIST`.
